title: End-to-end traceability
summary: Connect a requirement to affected components, meaningful checks and delivery evidence.

sections.label: Trace chain
sections.text:
Source or reviewed decision
 → required behavior
 → affected components and interfaces
 → meaningful checks
 → evidence for the delivered revision

sections.label: Example for a graph application
sections.text:
Requirement
 → ontology concepts and TTL
 → SPARQL behavior
 → Spring service and REST contract
 → React behavior
 → verification

sections.label: Bidirectional links
sections.text: From a requirement, find its implementation and checks. From a changed query, API, or test, identify the requirement and source decision it serves.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Relevant components and verification have revision-linked evidence. The map can expose missing links without guessing that every missing link is a defect.

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
